messages:
Maya: Following up on the postmortem actions for the late-night alert flood. We had a bunch of noise from redis pod flapping + very aggressive page rules. Need owners and short timelines.
Alex: I profiled the paging stream: 140 pages in 45m, ~65% were repeats for the same host. Two immediate wins: bump the alert window and increase grouping/dedupe. Also tighten non-prod paging so it doesn't wake folks.
Jordan: I can change thresholds today: set cpu_high to 90% over 5m (was 75%/1m), mem_pressure to 85%/5m. I'll add a dedupe grouping: group_by [alertname, instance, shard] with group_interval 10m.
Lee: I'll own routing and paging behavior. Plan: PR with new alertmanager route + inhibit rules by Thu. Will run canary in staging Friday.
Priya: I'll own the automation for page-rate detection. Proposal: alert if pages_per_service > 40 over 30m -> create ticket and auto-silence non-critical routes for 30m. Draft by Mon.
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-0416: summary pages=140 unique_hosts=28 duplicates=92 top_alerts=[redis_conn_timeout, cpu_spike], pattern=redis flaps roughly every 3h.
Maya: Add a check to capture top-5 alert fingerprints and attach to the PM doc so we can track recurring fingerprints month-over-month.
Alex: Example Alertmanager snippet to add to ops repo:
```
route:
  receiver: 'pager'
  group_by: ['alertname', 'instance', 'service']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 10m
  repeat_interval: 3h
```
Plus an inhibit: if redis_down (critical) -> suppress redis_conn_timeout for 30m.
Jordan: For non-prod, change pager receiver to 'ops-slack' and severity=warning so it doesn't page on first occurrence. We'll still log and create incidents in the tracking board.
Lee: Ownership recap:
- Lee: update alert routes + inhibit rules, PR Thu EOD, canary Fri
- Jordan: thresholds + grouping changes, PR today
- Priya: pages-per-service metric + automation, draft Mon
- Alex: update runbooks with new thresholds and test steps, by Mon
- Maya: update postmortem checklist and create GitHub milestone 'reduce-alert-noise-Q2', tracking owner=Maya, due next Tue
Priya: For automation, recommend creating a short-lived silence first 30m (no human page) and send a Slack summary to #oncall indicating the silence and ticket id.
Maya: Agree. If any blockers, call out in channel or DM. Let's close these items fast so the next incident isn't noisy. :white_check_mark:
